jobs.description:
Help redefine customer support for the AI era.

Most companies are running support on ticketing systems built in 2007, with AI bolted on as an afterthought.

Botpress is the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — built the other way around.

As the 3rd fastest-growing B2B AI start-up worldwide, we're displacing legacy platforms like Zendesk at scale — across industries, regions, and thousands of companies worldwide.

The work ahead is ambitious. The opportunity is rare. We take a deliberate approach to growth: product-led, capital-efficient, and highly focused.

If you want to build the customer support platform for the AI era, we're looking for top talent to join us.

**About the Role**

As a Software Developer at Botpress, you'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive the future of conversational AI. As part of the engineering team, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable applications that enhance the capabilities of our AI agent platform. You'll use your technical expertise to solve complex problems while ensuring the highest standards of code quality and performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy customer-impacting features
* Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to define and implement new features
* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers to ensure best practices and continuous improvement
* Participate in troubleshooting and debugging complex production issues
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation within the team

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

* Proven experience as a Software Engineer or similar role in a fast-paced environment
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and frameworks like React
* Solid understanding of software development principles, patterns, and methodologies
* Experience with cloud technologies (AWS) is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
* A passion for exploring new technologies and a desire to contribute to a rapidly evolving product
* An enthusiastic team player driven to achieve results and contribute to the overall success of Botpress

**About Botpress**

Botpress raised a $25 million Series B round in 2025. We're building the enterprise-grade AI agent platform for customer support — not by adding AI to old infrastructure, but by building AI-first from day one.

As a fast-growing start-up, we run a lean and innovative ship that leans on AI for maximum business impact. At Botpress, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective and talents. We intentionally hire individuals who are eager, passionate, talented, and hungry to learn and grow throughout their career.

You'll be on a team that's not just adapting to the AI revolution, but leading it. Joining our team means changing how millions of customers interact with the companies they do business with — and building the platform that defines the next era of customer support.

 **Benefits**  

* 4 weeks of vacation

* Paid sick and parental leave
* Comprehensive health, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance
* Funding for education and skills improvement
* Fully-stocked fridge and cupboard – we take snacks seriously
* A meaningful stock option grant — we want everyone at Botpress to think and act as an owner, and to share in what we build
* RRSP program with a 50% employer match on up to 4% of salary
* STM transit subsidy
* A beautiful, fully renovated office
* A vibrant office community including weekly socials

jobs.title: Jr. Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Invitation Project is committed to developing creative approaches to motivate, train, encourage, and support users in sharing the Christian gospel.**THE PROJECT**

We are building a subscription-based Evangelism platform to enable ordinary Christians to share their faith.

**THE POSITION**

We are seeking a motivated **Junior Full-Stack Developer** to join our team and help build the core infrastructure of our hybrid evangelism app. You will work closely with senior engineers to design, develop, and maintain the platform's **front and back end**, focusing on writing clean TypeScript/Node.js code and learning best practices for scalability.

This role is perfect for a candidate who is passionate about technology, eager to learn **hybrid mobile development (React Native / Flutter)**, and curious about **relational databases (PostgreSQL)**. You will collaborate in a supportive environment to help deliver an engaging user experience worldwide.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Collaborate** with senior developers to build and scale a hybrid mobile application.
* **Help manage** relational **SQL databases** and learn data modelling techniques.
* **Support the development** of backend REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript.
* **Help implement** new frontend features and UI components for mobile and web.
* **Ensure smooth authentication** using Firebase Auth / Auth0 / Supabase.
* **Integrate payment processing** with Stripe, PayPal, or Paddle for subscriptions.
* **Implement cloud storage solutions** (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Cloudflare R2).
* **Develop and maintain** push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) / OneSignal.
* **Optimize the application's performance and security**.
* **Collaborate** with designers, content managers, and other stakeholders.
* **Write clean, maintainable code** and follow software development best practices.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Must be a dedicated Christian and willing to sign a statement of faith
* Willingness to sign a non-disclosure, non-compete agreement.
* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar experience**.
* **Basic experience** with or a strong desire to learn full-stack development.
* **Familiarity** with modern frontend frameworks such as React, React Native, or Flutter, alongside HTML5/CSS3 and TypeScript.
* **Foundational knowledge** of backend programming and API concepts.
* **Experience working with relational databases** (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and ORMs such as Prisma or TypeORM.
* **Familiarity with cloud platforms** (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
* **Knowledge of authentication & security protocols** (OAuth, JWT, Firebase Auth, or Auth0).
* **Experience with payment gateway integration** (Stripe, PayPal, Paddle, etc.).
* **Understanding of Git version control and CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions, Docker) for efficient deployment.
* Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and receive constructive feedback.
* Ability to work **independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously**.
* Passion for evangelism and using technology to spread the Gospel.

**BENEFITS**

* Flexible working hours and **remote work options**.
* Opportunity to be part of a **mission-driven organization**.
* A collaborative and **supportive team environment**.
* The chance to **work on cutting-edge technology** for evangelism.

If you don't meet all these requirements but are excited by the opportunity, please feel free to apply anyway.

Pay: $60,000.00-$80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Flexible schedule
* On-site parking
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Burnaby, BC

jobs.description:
#### **Why should you consider joining Auvik?**

* **You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.** Auvik's network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It's more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.

* **You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy.** Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.

* **You want to work with a product customers love.** People rave about what we've built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.

* **You want regular opportunities for learning and growth.** With ongoing feedback from leadership, you'll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you're prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.

* **You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way.** We're a fully distributed team and we're prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

  

**What's this role about?**

As a software engineer at Auvik, you'll be part of an agile team of coders, developing a network management service that monitors millions of devices, while solving big challenges for our customers. Drawing on your love of developing creative solutions, your can-do attitude, and your drive to do great work, you'll help Auvik continue to build software our customers can rely on.

**What will I be doing?**

The industry is shifting towards cloud based systems and distributed work environments. We need senior software developers like yourself to level up on our product offerings. In this role, you will:

* Focus on designing architectures for microservices that are consistent, scalable, high quality and tolerant to faults and failures.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes orchestration.
* Design and implement protocols for communication in a highly scalable, distributed system.
* Develop reliable and performant code for our collector deployed at tens of thousands of customer sites.
* Develop tooling using information from Netflow, Syslog, and other networking standards.
* Help expand the depth and breadth of our solution based on your deep knowledge of networking devices and protocols.
* Collaborate with engineering and product management to deliver software components to meet the needs of our customers.
* Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.

**What are we looking for?**

* Proven experience developing quality code and architectures preferably using or Golang or Javascript).
* Background in designing and developing microservices.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Adept in building reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of the Kafka streaming platform.
* Proficiency in agile methodologies such as scrum.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD pipeline to test and deploy.
* Passion for mentoring and guiding junior and intermediate team members.
* Enthusiasm towards researching new technologies and making recommendations based on experiences and findings.
* Accountability towards following processes and making suggestions for improvements.
* Desire to collaboratively create elegant, scalable, modern, code that evolves our products.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) to work collaboratively with the immediate team and the larger organization.

**We're actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.**  
  
**About Auvik**

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We're focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you're excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

  

#### **Hiring Process**

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Hyper, a Motorola Solutions Company, is a leader in conversational, agentic AI designed to reduce the burden on understaffed public safety answering points (PSAPs) by handling non-emergency calls. It is revolutionizing emergency response systems through cutting-edge AI technologies. Our first product is reducing 911 wait times by alleviating administrative work from highly trained 911 telecommunicators.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the AI Agent Platform team behind Hyper’s emergency response products (Motorola Solutions announced that it acquired Hyper on April 9, 2026).

  
  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time AI pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build real-time voice AI features for emergency response workflows.
* Design and operate LLM-powered systems that support human 911 telecommunicators.
* Own features across the stack, from backend services and AI pipelines to frontend interfaces and internal tools.
* Work on low-latency audio processing, streaming systems, telephony integrations, and human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
* Help integrate speech models, LLMs, and emerging AI technologies into production systems.

* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Help write and improve evaluation, testing, and observability for AI-assisted systems.
* Participate in on-call responsibilities (with support and shadow rotations to start), backed by clear runbooks and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

**You Might Be a Fit If**
-------------------------

* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
* You want to work on AI systems that matter beyond demos.

**Relevant Experience**
-----------------------

We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.

Relevant exposure may include:

* Projects involving LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.
* Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Voice Activity Detection, endpointing, interruption handling, noise filtering, diarization, or audio streaming.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
* Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
* Programming in Elixir, Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL or relational data modeling.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Docker, Kubernetes, or similar deployment environments.
* Internships or co-ops in software engineering, infrastructure, or AI/ML roles.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest

  
  

#LI-RS1

#LI-Remote

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

Bachelor's degree

Experience with LLMs, AI agents, AI pipelines, RAG systems, evals, or prompt test harnesses.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

New Grad

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Remote Python Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world's leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a high-taste engineer with a strong eye for quality — someone who's worked hands-on with preference data and rubric creation, and knows what separates a good example from a great one. You communicate clearly and can synthesize complex technical work the way a strong MAI dev would: concise, structured, and easy for others to act on. You're comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and default to shipping over deliberating.

**What does day-to-day look like:**

* Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
* Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
* Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
* Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, or recommendations for the team
* Collaborate closely with researchers/engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes

**Required Skills:**

* Proficiency in Python (especially building/maintaining pipelines and infra) or Typescript (experience contributing to or navigating large codebases like VSCode a plus)
* Hands-on experience with preference data collection and/or rubric creation
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to distill technical work into clear, actionable summaries
* Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

**Perks of Freelancing With Turing:**

* Work in a fully remote environment.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

**Engagement Details:**

* **Compensation:** Market rate. Please share a specific rate expectation (rather than a range) so we can quickly assess mutual fit
* **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with a minimum 6-hour overlap with Pacific Time. If you're unable to commit to 40 hours, please share your available hours and overlap window
* **Employment Type:** Independent contractor (does not include medical or paid leave benefits
* **Duration:** 3 months, with an expected start date as soon as possible

**Evaluation Process (approximately 30 mins):**

* One round of interview (30 mins of technical & cultural discussion)

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Help Deliver the Future of Usage-Based Billing**

LogiSense is looking for a Software Developer to help build and enhance our usage-based billing platform. You’ll bring strong C#, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server skills, along with experience applying other technologies to solve problems. AI tools are part of your everyday development workflow, and you know how to validate their results.

You’ll work within a cross-functional sprint team and across the wider organization to turn customer and business needs into reliable improvements to the LogiSense Billing platform.

At LogiSense, we believe billing should be simple and transparent. Our cloud-based billing and monetization platform helps innovative companies automate and scale complex usage-based and subscription billing models. Your work will turn customer and business needs into platform features that support that mission.

**Why Join LogiSense?**

* Remote-first culture with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
* A people-first environment that values integrity, balance, accountability, and innovation
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and funded learning and development

opportunities

* Ownership of complex features from design through delivery, with room to exercise your technical judgment
* Opportunities to apply your broader technical skills and AI-assisted development practices to real customer and business problems
* A chance to strengthen the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and improvements to how we build software

**The Role**

As a Software Developer at LogiSense, you’ll own complex features spanning multiple application components, from design through delivery.You’ll help clarify requirements, make well-reasoned technical decisions, and work with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address testing and regression risks. Your ownership extends to supporting the software you deliver and improving its reliability in collaboration with IT and Support.

You’ll organize and prioritize your work with minimal supervision, provide realistic estimates, and raise risks early. You’ll know when to work through a problem independently and when to involve others. Through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing, you’ll help colleagues grow while contributing improvements to shared code and development practices.

At LogiSense, we live by three core values: Be good. Seek balance. Get paid. They guide everything we

do - and we hope they resonate with you too.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* Strong experience developing enterprise applications with C# and .NET, plus experience applying other technologies to solve problems.
* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, T-SQL, and query optimization.
* Experience with at least one of Node.js or a modern UI framework.
* Practical experience incorporating AI tools into your everyday development workflow, understanding their limitations, validating their results, and sharing effective practices.
* Experience designing, implementing, and integrating with RESTful APIs.
* The ability to own complex features across multiple application components, from design through delivery, with minimal supervision.
* The ability to break down requirements into development tasks, identify dependencies, provide realistic estimates, and communicate risks early.
* Sound judgment in software design decisions and technical tradeoffs, including knowing when to involve others.
* A systematic approach to debugging, performance profiling, and optimization.
* Experience implementing automated unit and functional tests, and working with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address integration and regression risks.
* The ability to work with Product and other stakeholders to understand user needs and clarify requirements, and communicate technical decisions through documentation, walkthroughs, and discussions.
* The ability to develop a broad understanding of the LogiSense Billing platform and deep expertise in the components you support.
* The ability to mentor teammates through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* A commitment to supporting and improving the reliability of the software you deliver, in collaboration with IT and Support.
* Initiative to improve shared code, address technical debt, and strengthen development practices.

Strongly Preferred:

* Experience building, deploying, or supporting applications on AWS or another cloud platform.
* Experience working within Scrum or another Agile development process.

**Find Your Balance With Us**

Flexible Work, Built Around You

* Remote-first work within Canada, with flexibility and collaboration built into how we work
* A culture of trust and autonomy where your results matter more than where you sit

Well-Being & Growth

* Generous paid time off, holidays, and a company-wide holiday shutdown
* Dedicated time and funding for personal learning, certifications, and professional development
* A collaborative and respectful environment where you can grow - and help others grow too
* Opportunities to take on challenging work that expands your skill set and impact

**Get Paid What You're Worth**

Compensation & Benefits

* Annual base salary range of CAD $100,000 - $120,000, plus annual bonus potential of up to 10% of base salary with RRSP matching
* A comprehensive benefits package covering dental, vision, prescription, and extended healthcare that begins on day one
* Paid vacation and additional company holidays

Additional Perks

* Access to stock options and equity for long-term, high-impact contributors
* Team events, company swag, and a culture that celebrates people, passion, and progress

**More Than Just a Job**

At LogiSense, we're not checking boxes - we're building a team of sharp, curious, and driven people who care about what they do and how they do it. We offer autonomy, flexibility, and competitive pay and benefits because we believe great work h

**Help Deliver the Future of Usage-Based Billing**

LogiSense is looking for a Software Developer to help build and enhance our usage-based billing platform. You’ll bring strong C#, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server skills, along with experience applying other technologies to solve problems. AI tools are part of your everyday development workflow, and you know how to validate their results.

You’ll work within a cross-functional sprint team and across the wider organization to turn customer and business needs into reliable improvements to the LogiSense Billing platform.

At LogiSense, we believe billing should be simple and transparent. Our cloud-based billing and monetization platform helps innovative companies automate and scale complex usage-based and subscription billing models. Your work will turn customer and business needs into platform features that support that mission.

**Why Join LogiSense?**

* Remote-first culture with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
* A people-first environment that values integrity, balance, accountability, and innovation
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and funded learning and development

opportunities

* Ownership of complex features from design through delivery, with room to exercise your technical judgment
* Opportunities to apply your broader technical skills and AI-assisted development practices to real customer and business problems
* A chance to strengthen the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and improvements to how we build software

**The Role**

As a Software Developer at LogiSense, you’ll own complex features spanning multiple application components, from design through delivery.You’ll help clarify requirements, make well-reasoned technical decisions, and work with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address testing and regression risks. Your ownership extends to supporting the software you deliver and improving its reliability in collaboration with IT and Support.

You’ll organize and prioritize your work with minimal supervision, provide realistic estimates, and raise risks early. You’ll know when to work through a problem independently and when to involve others. Through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing, you’ll help colleagues grow while contributing improvements to shared code and development practices.

At LogiSense, we live by three core values: Be good. Seek balance. Get paid. They guide everything we

do - and we hope they resonate with you too.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* Strong experience developing enterprise applications with C# and .NET, plus experience applying other technologies to solve problems.
* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, T-SQL, and query optimization.
* Experience with at least one of Node.js or a modern UI framework.
* Practical experience incorporating AI tools into your everyday development workflow, understanding their limitations, validating their results, and sharing effective practices.
* Experience designing, implementing, and integrating with RESTful APIs.
* The ability to own complex features across multiple application components, from design through delivery, with minimal supervision.
* The ability to break down requirements into development tasks, identify dependencies, provide realistic estimates, and communicate risks early.
* Sound judgment in software design decisions and technical tradeoffs, including knowing when to involve others.
* A systematic approach to debugging, performance profiling, and optimization.
* Experience implementing automated unit and functional tests, and working with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address integration and regression risks.
* The ability to work with Product and other stakeholders to understand user needs and clarify requirements, and communicate technical decisions through documentation, walkthroughs, and discussions.
* The ability to develop a broad understanding of the LogiSense Billing platform and deep expertise in the components you support.
* The ability to mentor teammates through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* A commitment to supporting and improving the reliability of the software you deliver, in collaboration with IT and Support.
* Initiative to improve shared code, address technical debt, and strengthen development practices.

Strongly Preferred:

* Experience building, deploying, or supporting applications on AWS or another cloud platform.
* Experience working within Scrum or another Agile development process.

**Find Your Balance With Us**

Flexible Work, Built Around You

* Remote-first work within Canada, with flexibility and collaboration built into how we work
* A culture of trust and autonomy where your results matter more than where you sit

Well-Being & Growth

* Generous paid time off, holidays, and a company-wide holiday shutdown
* Dedicated time and funding for personal learning, certifications, and professional development
* A collaborative and respectful environment where you can grow - and help others grow too
* Opportunities to take on challenging work that expands your skill set and impact

**Get Paid What You're Worth**

Compensation & Benefits

* Annual base salary range of CAD $100,000 - $120,000, plus annual bonus potential of up to 10% of base salary with RRSP matching
* A comprehensive benefits package covering dental, vision, prescription, and extended healthcare that begins on day one
* Paid vacation and additional company holidays

Additional Perks

* Access to stock options and equity for long-term, high-impact contributors
* Team events, company swag, and a culture that celebrates people, passion, and progress

**More Than Just a Job**

At LogiSense, we're not checking boxes - we're building a team of sharp, curious, and driven people who care about what they do and how they do it. We offer autonomy, flexibility, and competitive pay and benefits because we believe great work h

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Information**
  
Job Requisition ID: 88284
  
Ministry: Technology and Innovation
  
Location: Edmonton
  
Full or Part-Time: Full-Time
  
Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week
  
Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent
  
Scope: Open Competition
  
Closing Date: October 13, 2026
  
Classification: Systems Analyst 1
  
Salary: $2,533.72 to $3,799.96 bi-weekly ($66,130 - $99,178/year)

  

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

  

Technology and Innovation is responsible for making innovation and technology the driving force behind Alberta’s economic growth and diversification.

  

The Digital Design and Delivery (DDD) division is the Government of Alberta’s centre of digital delivery. It partners with ministries to design simpler, faster, and better services; build capability and confidence in modern digital practices; and assure service quality and value through standards and controls. Multidisciplinary product teams are assigned priority GoA projects and employ an agile, product-oriented approach in providing solutions for ministry partners.

  

Within DDD, the Software Delivery Branch provides architectural leadership, CloudOps, DevOps practices, quality engineering, and software delivery excellence across product and platform teams. The Digital Architect plays a key role in shaping how digital solutions are designed, evolved, and governed, balancing innovation with reliability, security, and public sector responsibility.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------

The Software Delivery branch is looking for six (6) Junior Full Stack Developers (FSD). Reporting to the Director, Software Development, this role supports the team in the design and implementation of software with a focus on iterative, continuous development, where requirements and solutions evolve through collaboration between cross-functional teams and users.

  

This role explicitly requires AI capability, creating systems with AI as a co-developer. So, we are seeking developers who can build, integrate, and optimize AI-driven solutions in addition to traditional front-end and back-end development.

  

The responsibilities of this role include:

* Develop and maintain front-end and back-end solutions, including AI-enabled features and digital services.
* Collaborate with agile teams, stakeholders, and users to design, build, and improve digital products.
* Contribute to backlog planning, effort estimation, and the delivery of high-quality software features.
* Apply development best practices, including testing, code reviews, CI/CD automation, and source control.
* Research emerging technologies and AI tools to identify opportunities for innovation and service improvement.
* Provide technical support and recommendations while communicating solutions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  

To be successful in this position, you will demonstrate:

* Ability to self-learn a variety of software tools.
* Ability to keep up with industry standards and new tools or resources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position

**APS Competencies**
--------------------

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

  

* **Builds Collaborative Environment**: Engages diverse stakeholders and fosters collaboration through shared resources and inclusive dialogue. Resolves conflict through facilitation and coaching while valuing different perspectives to achieve outcomes.
* **Creative Problem Solving:** Uses diverse approaches to analyze problems and generate solutions. Encourages collaboration and brings the right people together to resolve issues.
* **Agility:** Adapts quickly to changing priorities and incorporates improvements into work. Stays composed under pressure and helps others adjust to change.
* **Develop Self and Others:** Builds individual and team capability through learning and development. Promotes shared learning and supports personal development planning.
* **Systems Thinking:** Considers broader trends, risks, and context when making decisions. Aligns actions with organizational goals and addresses barriers to progress.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Requirements:**

* A related two-year diploma in computer technology or a related discipline from a recognized post-secondary institution.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including secure, scalable application development, testing, CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, source control, code reviews, and the full software development lifecycle.).
* A cover letter clearly demonstrating relevant skills and competencies tailored to this position.
  

**Equivalencies:**

* A related one-year certificate from a recognized post-secondary institution and one (1) year of related experience.
  

**Assets:**

* Experience designing, developing, and supporting modern full-stack applications using front-end technologies, back-end services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, and scalable enterprise architectures.
* Experience developing, integrating, and supporting AI-powered applications using modern frameworks, APIs, cloud services, automation platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of AI software engineering practices, including responsible AI principles, governance requirements, secure development, deployment, monitoring, API integration, and enterprise technology standards.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation technologies to solve business problems, improve efficiency and user experience, and collaborate effectively wi

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - Golang & Nodejs
jobs.description:
CGI is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team and help design, build, and evolve production-grade backend systems and cloud-native platforms. This role is ideal for a senior software professional with deep expertise in Go, strong Node.js development experience, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud services, CI/CD, and engineering automation. As a key member of the engineering team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, deployment, and operational excellence of scalable backend services while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who brings sound engineering judgment, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps elevate team decision-making through thoughtful collaboration and technical leadership. This is a full-time permanent opportunity.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and distributed systems using Go.
* Contribute to full-stack application development using Node.js and React.
* Design and implement secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services.
* Build, maintain, and optimize cloud-native solutions using AWS services and modern cloud engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and engineering tooling.
* Create and maintain Bash scripts and automation solutions to improve development and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and architectural improvements early in the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members, promote engineering best practices, and contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant professional experience developing enterprise backend or platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience developing production-grade backend services using Go.
* Experience with full-stack or backend development using Node.js.
* Experience developing modern web applications using React.
* Strong understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development.
* Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Strong scripting experience using Bash or similar scripting languages.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and scalable distributed systems.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate technical trade-offs effectively, work independently, and contribute positively to technical discussions and decision-making.

  
Assets  
The following qualifications would be considered assets:  

* Experience with distributed systems, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience working with both legacy and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience improving software reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
* Experience mentoring software developers and providing technical leadership.
* Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries.

  
CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000-$145,000 CAD. This role is an existing vacancy.  
  
#LI-HG

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  
  
At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  
  
To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.
